decisions.reason: The FAQ already states that a no-referral commission goes to a random existing NFT holder; the separate ticket uncertainty is not part of this commission-allocation MODIFY.
The commission-recipient decision does not determine whether no-referral mints generate tickets; that question is already represented by the candidate's same-message AMBIGUOUS Event.
This candidate governs commissions when a referral code is used, whereas the source decision applies only to mints without a referral code.
The source preserves the $15 price and $5 commission amount and only specifies the recipient of the commission in the no-referral path, which is owned by the source Requirement.
The landing-page mechanics copy describes commissions earned through referrals and is not changed by the no-referral commission-recipient policy.
Changing the recipient-selection policy for no-referral commissions does not alter the requirement that awarded commissions be displayed accurately and consistently.
The source decision does not change referral-code identity, lifetime, sharing, display, or resale behavior.
Referral-code validity rules remain unchanged, and the existing no/invalid-code feedback already states that the $5 goes to a random existing NFT holder.
This candidate governs ticket issuance when a referral code is used; the source decision concerns commission allocation when no referral code is used.
The wallet-provisioning and access behavior remains unchanged regardless of which existing NFT holder receives a no-referral commission.
The source decision does not change the Small Block prize amount, trigger, funding, eligibility window, or ticket reset behavior.
The no-referral commission-recipient policy does not change the requirement that public referral statistics accurately reflect recorded referral activity.
